title: festuca ovina subsp. supina
intro: Festuca ovina subsp. supina, commonly known as Sheeps' Fescue, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, alleviate digestive issues, and act as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina subsp. supina include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which make it a useful remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
